item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The UNODA page records that the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Article 2 TPNW declaration was received on 25 April 2023.","notes":["The excerpt states a date received, not necessarily the date the DRC submitted the declaration."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-E007","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"On 28 June 2023, at least 12 FARDC soldiers arrested and beat three journalists covering a Kinshasa land dispute; the journalists were released without charges, with Ngoyi and Nkelani released after intervention by the UN mission to the DRC.
